title: Who Verifies the Graph? Misspecification Attacks on Causal Action Verification for Language Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.40027v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Causal action verifiers gate an agent's state-changing tool calls by checking whether each proposed intervention is identifiable against a committed action-state graph, and they issue a certificate that carries the identification argument and a one-sided lower confidence bound. One such verifier, CIVeX, reports zero false executions on a confounded tool-use benchmark. We red-team it by corrupting only the committed graph. Omitting a single bidirected edge takes it from zero false executions to 15.3% at the benchmark's published confounding strength, with 91% of its executions harmful and utility falling from +2.27 to +0.35. Reversing one arrowhead, so that a mediator is committed as a confounder, gives 48.9% false executions and no correct ones. Every one of these actions carries an internally valid certificate. translated_title: 谁来验证图？针对语言智能体因果动作验证的误设攻击
translated_abstract: 因果动作验证器通过检查每个提议的干预相对于已提交的动作-状态图是否可识别，来把关智能体的状态改变型工具调用，并颁发包含识别论证和单侧置信下界的证书。其中一个名为CIVeX的验证器在一个混杂工具使用基准上报告了零次虚假执行。我们通过仅篡改已提交的图对该验证器进行了红队测试。省略一条双向边，在基准所公布的混杂强度下，使其虚假执行率从零上升到15.3%，其中91%的执行是有害的，效用从+2.27降至+0.35。反转一个箭头，使中介变量被错误提交为混杂变量，则导致48.9%的虚假执行且没有正确的执行。上述每次攻击都携带内部有效的证书。一个证明步骤，即通过有界随机样本对每个经观察认证的执行进行测试，成功检测到了这两次攻击（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文通过仅篡改已提交的因果图（如省略一条双向边或反转一个箭头）对因果动作验证器CIVeX发起误设攻击，使其产生大量携带有效证书的有害执行，并提出一种基于有界随机样本的证明步骤来检测此类攻击。
en_tdlr: The paper demonstrates misspecification attacks on the causal action verifier CIVeX by corrupting only the committed graph—omitting a bidirected edge or reversing an arrowhead—causing harmful false executions with internally valid certificates, and proposes an attestation step using bounded randomised samples to detect such attacks.
